Wake up to the sea in Cape Coast

Harbour Light Guesthouse is a family-run guesthouse ten minutes from Cape Coast Castle. Every room opens onto a shared sea-view terrace, and breakfast is cooked fresh each morning by our kitchen team.

Why guests stay with us

  • Sea-view terrace open from sunrise
  • Home-cooked breakfast included with every room
  • Ten minutes on foot from Cape Coast Castle
  • Air-conditioned rooms with private bathrooms

Rooms and rates

Terrace suite from GH₵680 per night.
